branchReviews.name: Frozen order
branchReviews.summary: The real TOP recipe goes directly from Intermediate Frozen Paladin to Glacial High Paladin. Paladin Oathbreaker is a separate terminal Advanced control specialist with a stronger aura than Frozen Paladin and extra Freeze/air coverage.

Each bounce retains 50% of the previous packet's damage, starting from the defender's unbuffed listed primary damage. The first bounce deals 50% of that base; bounce n deals base × 0.5^n. Ricochet packets cannot critically strike, apply on-hit statuses, trigger abilities or carry Splash. The independent one-origin Splash/Cleave rule remains separate.

abilities.name: Breach seal

Suppress Physical immunity for 3 s, or 1.5 s on bosses, then shared 4 s target recovery. Start 8 s source cooldown only when a target is found. Never needs a damaging hit; no refresh, overlap or recovery bypass. Armor, evasion, Magical immunity and independent control immunity remain.

abilities.name: Scored rune
abilities.text: A landed eligible Magical primary rune strike reduces armor by 12 for 3 s, Scored rune strongest-only. Magical immunity blocks this hit and debuff; Physical immunity does not block the rune hit. The separate Breach seal pulse still suppresses only Physical immunity.

abilities.name: Rune splash
abilities.text: Every third primary releases 230 Magical rune damage to at most 2 other distinct visible ground or air enemies within 1.2 tiles. Each victim checks Magical immunity, evasion and its own defenses; splash never suppresses immunity.

abilities.name: Ready reserve
abilities.text: Each pulse may prefer two different eligible immune enemies. It never spends a target slot on a currently breached or recovering enemy. This is target selection, not an additional pulse.

abilities.name: Rune Lantern
abilities.text: Passive extended detection reveals otherwise cloaked enemies within 4 tiles to the whole army while this defender is retained, active and legally placed. It removes concealment only, never Evasion, damage/status immunity, armor or protected phases. Provisional and inactive draft units do not detect; pausing this defender's attacks or ordinary disarm does not disable its passive detector.

positionRules.application: Check the partner and snapshot the bonus when an attack is released. Add 20% of the unbuffed listed direct primary damage; do not multiply another damage buff. No retroactive change to an in-flight projectile.

positionRules.stacking: At most +20% total from the Position group on each eligible beneficiary. Multiple partners, duplicate copies and multiple compatible pair definitions do not stack or refresh a timed buff. The condition is continuous, not a timed buff.

steps.label: Ricochet I
steps.rule: Each direct attack release has a 20% chance to ricochet from its first selected primary target to up to one additional distinct enemy, with each jump reaching up to 3 tiles. Each bounce retains 50% of the previous packet's damage, starting from the defender's unbuffed listed primary damage. The first bounce deals 50% of that base; bounce n deals base × 0.5^n. Roll once per release. Exclude every directly hit victim, never hit an enemy twice and never bounce back. Use the listed primary damage channel and direct target eligibility; normal defenses apply. Ricochet packets cannot critically strike, apply on-hit statuses, trigger abilities or carry Splash. The independent one-origin Splash/Cleave rule remains separate.

from.rule: Direct attacks have a 10% chance to deal ×5 damage. Burn, Poison and auras do not critically strike.

to.name: Critical Strike
to.label: Critical Strike II
to.rule: Direct attacks have a 20% chance to deal ×5 damage. Burn, Poison and auras do not critically strike.

from.name: Ricochet
from.label: Ricochet III
from.rule: Each direct attack release has a 40% chance to ricochet from its first selected primary target to up to 3 additional distinct enemies, with each jump reaching up to 3 tiles. Each bounce retains 70% of the previous packet's damage, starting from the defender's unbuffed listed primary damage. The first bounce deals 70% of that base; bounce n deals base × 0.7^n. Roll once per release. Exclude every directly hit victim, never hit an enemy twice and never bounce back. Use the listed primary damage channel and direct target eligibility; normal defenses apply. Ricochet packets cannot critically strike, apply on-hit statuses, trigger abilities or carry Splash. The independent one-origin Splash/Cleave rule remains separate.

to.name: Ricochet
to.label: Ricochet IV
to.rule: Each direct attack release has a 50% chance to ricochet from its first selected primary target to up to 4 additional distinct enemies, with each jump reaching up to 3 tiles. Each bounce retains 80% of the previous packet's damage, starting from the defender's unbuffed listed primary damage. The first bounce deals 80% of that base; bounce n deals base × 0.8^n. Roll once per release. Exclude every directly hit victim, never hit an enemy twice and never bounce back. Use the listed primary damage channel and direct target eligibility; normal defenses apply. Ricochet packets cannot critically strike, apply on-hit statuses, trigger abilities or carry Splash. The independent one-origin Splash/Cleave rule remains separate.

from.name: Armor Penetration

abilities.rule: Continuously deal 360 damage/s to every ground enemy in a 75° cone reaching 4 tiles. There is no enemy-count limit. The damage type is the defender's listed damage type.

abilities.name: Heat
abilities.label: Heat VI
abilities.rule: Every 4 s, release 700 Physical Heat damage to all ground enemies within 1.5 tiles of the current target in attack range. The burst does not trigger other abilities.

abilities.name: Range Aura
abilities.label: Range Aura I
abilities.rule: Allies within 5 tiles gain +1 tiles of direct attack reach, including Flame Cone reach. Aura radii and cone angles are unchanged; only the strongest Range Aura applies.

units.name: Nightweaver Spider
units.role: Magical defender. Abilities: Armor Reduction.
units.frontDesign: A slate-gray DROW with clearly visible WHITE hair, pointed ears and a sharp silver collar; one small CRESCENT SICKLE in the right hand and a flat silver MOON DISC in the left. Lunar hex specialist, not another staff mage. Cold silver-lilac moonlight, no red robe, flame or orange crystal. Latest approved geometric FRONT style: broad beveled head, two square eyes, short chunky limbs, visible planar facets, clean matte colors, full figure on a warm sandy octagonal base. No realism, filigree, environmental scenery, floating labels or copied obsolete model thumbnails.

branchReviews.name: Sky rangers
branchReviews.before: Sky Hunt stays at 20% throughout. Multishot remains at 2 targets through Advanced. The Captain’s Range Aura disappears at Advanced and TOP; Armor Reduction stays at 2.
branchReviews.after: Sky Hunt grows 20/30/40/50%. Multishot grows 2/2/3/10 targets. The Captain’s +1 range aura remains on both Advanced choices; TOP upgrades to +3. Armor Reduction grows 4 at Advanced to 8 at TOP.
branchReviews.draftRecipeAlignment: The consumed Sky Ranger ranks supply 20/30/40/40% anti-air bonuses at ranks II/III/V/VI. The matching champions use 20/30/40/50%. Multishot IV remains exactly 10 targets and TOP-only.
branchReviews.physicalGuardrail: TOP expected ordinary primary against air before defense 794.12/s; Human Ranger Oathbreaker unchanged Physical primary 3860/s, before its statuses. This is not a campaign-balance proof.
branchReviews.summary: The five Sky Ranger champions no longer have Sky Hunt or Range Aura. Their existing direct targeting, Multishot and armor-reduction levels remain; Skyshear retains its selective Critical Strike. The six unselected Grove Archer draft profiles keep their original Sky Hunt.

branchReviews.after: Retain the existing four immunity rules. Protection grows 25/50/100%; Anti-Regeneration grows 50% for 3 seconds to 100% for 3 seconds and then 100% for 4 seconds. Damage Aura grows 10% at Advanced to 50% at TOP.

Use case: stylized-concept. New HUMAN concept-revision contact sheet, using the supplied images as immutable STYLE REFERENCES only. Match the current Geometric V7/V8 approved source artwork and existing Human chibi proposals: large cuboid head, simple black square eyes, short connected limbs, broad matte low-poly bevels, warm ivory studio and a low sandy octagonal pedestal under every subject. No realistic adult faces, fine ornament or faceless helmets.
Exactly FOUR equal columns × THREE equal rows on landscape 3:2 canvas. Cells01..11 contain specified complete front-facing subjects, row-major. Lastcell12 blank ivory. Each full body, weapon, wings(ifany), machine and pedestal stays inside its owncell with safety margin. Finegray dividers, small indexONLY top-left01..11, no names or title. Keep camera front and equipment gripped coherently. No environmental scenery or gameplay UI.
01 Lightning Weaver: Human lightning caster with a navy-blue angular hood, white and silver robe edging, one forked blue crystal staff and five separate clean lightning-tip prisms. No fire or orange crystals.
02 Stormbow Magister: Advanced Human hooded battle-mage with navy-silver layered robe and fitted shoulder plates. One tall bow-shaped arcane staff, a small quiver motif and ten blue-white crystal points combine Lightning Weaver with Royal Scout and Royal Marksman.
03 Stormfire Sorcerer: Advanced Human sorcerer with a deep navy hood covering the hair, crimson inner cowl, broad silver shoulders, blue branching lightning staff and a contained orange fire brazier. Serious simple square-eyed face.
04 Grand Pyromancer: Solemn TOP Human elder in a deep charcoal hood, crimson and ivory layered robes, broad dark-gold shoulders and a stern clean square face. One tri-elemental staff has a large orange flame crystal, a clear blue lightning fork and a separate small sealed green poison flask on the belt. All three elements distinct and readable; no comical pointed hat.
05 Frozen Paladin: Human frozen paladin entirely styled in broad pale-blue ice plate with ivory frost edges, faceted ice helmet around a human square-eyed face, a massive solid ice warhammer in the right hand and a hexagonal ice shield left. Icy boots and shoulders, no robe, halo or wings.
06 Glacial High Paladin: TOP Human ice paladin: large crowned ice helmet, deep-blue hood beneath it, massive cyan crystal shoulders, silver-white frost armor and long split navy cape. Right tall ice hammer-staff, left broad frost shield with a small gold sacred emblem. Clearly a stronger evolution of Frozen Paladin, no angel wings.
07 Tempest Sovereign: TOP Human lightning ruler evolving Stormbow Magister: navy hood under a small angular silver-gold crown, broad white-blue royal mantle, long bow-shaped lightning staff and three large blue-white lightning crystals fanned from the off hand. No orange fire.
08 Fire Ballista: Heavy Human wooden ballista with brass corner braces, four wooden wheels, one loaded broad iron bolt with a clearly orange burning head, two compact covered coal braziers attached safely to the frame and scorched dark bow tips. This remains a ballista, never a cannon.
09 Cannon: Human royal single-barrel cannon: exactly ONE broad dark iron muzzle pointing toward viewer, a blue-and-brass reinforced wheeled carriage, two large wheels, and a compact human gunner beside its rear loading lever. No bird, wings, griffin or rider.
10 Royal Battery: TOP Human artillery battery with EXACTLY THREE distinct dark cannon muzzles in one horizontal row, parallel barrels fixed to a single broad royal blue-and-brass carriage. Four wheels, a compact human crewman behind, a small sealed green poison canister and clearly visible central royal emblem. No fourth barrel, no crossbow, no balloon or animal.
11 Paladin Oathbreaker: Advanced Human paladin with a deep charcoal-blue hood, ice-silver angular armor, a broken sacred emblem, one broad pale-cyan frost sword and a dark steel shield edged with ice. Human square-eyed face stays visible; no wings or halo, no red demonic fire.
Crucial machine counts: cell08 is a BOW ballista with one flaming BOLT, cell09 is a cannon with EXACTLYONE barrel, cell10 RoyalBattery has EXACTLYTHREE large circular cannon muzzles in one row, not four. All Human faces have rounded ears, no elf ears or dwarfbeards. Lightningblue/white is distinct from orangefire and greenpoison. Paladins in05,06,11 haveice armor andhuman faces, noangelwings. positionPolicy.adjacency: One shared cardinal edge; Manhattan tile distance exactly 1. Diagonal and distance-two placements do not qualify.
positionPolicy.eligibility: Both named ordinary champions must be retained, active and legally placed. Draft basics, temporary draft previews, inactive/reserved units, enemies and Lady Claire cannot act as named partners.
positionPolicy.application: Check the partner and snapshot the bonus when an attack is released. Add 20% of the unbuffed listed direct primary damage; do not multiply another damage buff. No retroactive change to an in-flight projectile.
positionPolicy.scope: Primary packet only. Never secondary hits, splash, bounces, vents, burns, poison, fields, auras, breach pulses, armor reduction, debuff strength/duration or support.
positionPolicy.stacking: At most +20% total from the Position group on each eligible beneficiary. Multiple partners, duplicate copies and multiple compatible pair definitions do not stack or refresh a timed buff. The condition is continuous, not a timed buff.
positionPolicy.loss: An inactive or removed partner stops qualification for future releases immediately; already released primary packets keep the snapshot. Pausing combat freezes normal combat time.

abilityPolicy.summary: Current approved FR-003 immunity auras and selected champion statistics; game implementation remains separate.
abilityPolicy.immunity: Continuous auras allow the listed fraction of normal matching damage through immunity while an enemy is inside the radius. Use only the strongest matching aura; other defenses still apply.
abilityPolicy.continuous: Continuous cones use explicit damage per second and listed ground-target rules. Attack speed does not increase continuous DPS.
abilityPolicy.weaponCycle: Magazine, shot cadence, spin-up and reload are profile properties. Primary cycle DPS includes the complete unbuffed cycle.
abilityPolicy.multishot: Each profile states its actual number of distinct direct targets. A target count is not inferred from the Roman variant label.
abilityPolicy.areaAttackRule: Structured faction Splash and Cleave originate from the first selected primary target and exclude every directly hit victim. Human runtime cleave follows its separately listed attack and critical rules.
abilityPolicy.independentEffects: Independent damage-over-time, auras and timed abilities use their own actual rules. Human Poison stacks independently per damaging hit; structured faction Poison uses its assigned stacking rule.
abilityPolicy.execution: Execution uses its profile cooldown and boss critical multiplier. Do not infer a global cooldown from a historical catalogue level.
abilityPolicy.targeting: Ground-only, air-only and ground-and-air flags describe direct targeting. Independent auras and secondary effects retain their own eligibility.
abilityPolicy.slowImmunity: Current Human and faction movement effects respect the current Physical-immunity eligibility rules. Old proposed Human Ranger bypass flags are not implemented and are not shown as current abilities.
abilityPolicy.critical: One ordinary Critical Strike family; the four former magical critical assignments use the same chance/multiplier contract and retain their own attack damage type.
abilityPolicy.ricochet: Proposed any-positive-owned-hit trigger with finite distinct bounces, no bounce-distance limit, critical hits and ordinary on-hit effects. Technical event scheduling remains a later implementation contract.
abilityPolicy.moonStrike: Proposed 20% chance per main direct attack impact, separate Holy bonus, no attack counter or blanket immunity bypass.
abilityPolicy.source: FR-005 gallery proposal based on implemented FR-004 in game 0.6.7
abilityPolicy.ordering: Global levels ascend by stated potency. Each shared level label has one catalogue row; meaningful owner-specific conditions remain explicit. Exact retained labels can leave retired number gaps.
abilityPolicy.skyHunt: Physical damage bonuses remain +50/+60/+75%. Add a continuous air-only 25/50/75% movement-slow aura within 3/4/5 tiles. It requires no hit, applies only while the enemy is inside an active aura, leaves no lingering slow and respects existing Slow immunity and strongest-only slowing.
abilityPolicy.splash: Shared Splash I–V radii are 2, 2.25, 2.5, 2.75 and 3 tiles. Damage percentages and other existing parameters remain exact.
abilityPolicy.human: Only the explicitly requested Golem Stone Gaze to Stun substitution and any globally shared Splash radius assignments may change Human abilities. Human primary values and all Human recipes remain exact.
